bio: I’m a junior at the University of Michigan studying mathematics with a minor in computer science. I’m drawn to challenging problems that require precise formulation, creative thinking, and an understanding of why a solution works. My mathematical interests lie broadly in computational mathematics, with a particular focus on topology, combinatorics, optimization, and the use of mathematical modeling to understand complex problems. Looking ahead, I hope to build a career in mathematics, especially in applied research in academia or industry.

posts.title: PBMC’s New AI in Math Initiative
posts.body: I’m excited to share the University of Michigan’s Proof Based Math Club’s new initiative: AI in Math! We’ll be exploring how AI can support the development and understanding of mathematical proofs, while giving members hands-on experience with Lean and proof formalization. Our goal is to learn together, experiment with AI-assisted proof ideas, and investigate both the possibilities and limitations of these tools.
posts.label: Explore our AI in Math repository

news.body: Steven, Colin, and I have just entered the 2026 International Cryptology Olympiad team competition (October 12–19). We’re excited to see how we place!
